name: @aico/video
description: aico video URL: review or question a YouTube video. Gemini watches it with the cleaned captions attached; captions-only and transcript-only fallbacks are reported; results are cached per video.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --log-level=error --outfile=dist/aico-video.mjs --banner:js="// Aico video bundle. Built by npm run build; do not edit.
import { createRequire as __aicoRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __aicoRequire(import.meta.url);"
